function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT period,
       SUM(revenue_cad) AS total_revenue_cad,
       SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
       SUM(revenue_cad)/SUM(qty) AS avg_price_per_unit
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line
WHERE period IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period","purpose":"Check overall average selling price per unit for Aug and Sep 2026"}
